277538229.description:
Polished Agate Geode Bookends
Natural Stone with Banded Pattern and Crystalline Druzy
Modern Organic Style, 5.38 lb Set
This pair of bookends is crafted from a single geode, split and polished to reveal the intricate concentric banding characteristic of natural agate. The contrast between the rough, earth-toned exterior and the smooth, luminous interior faces makes these pieces both functional office accessories and striking geological specimens. Naturally occurring druzy quartz crystals are visible in the central cavities, adding a delicate sparkle to the organic forms.
Authentic agate geode cut into a matching pair of bookends
Polished faces showcase grey, tan, and cream concentric banding
Natural rough stone exterior with organic texture
Combined weight of 5.38 lbs for secure support of book collections
Dimensions: 8.5" L x 7.5" W x 6" H
Condition:
Very good condition. Polished surfaces are smooth with excellent clarity and minimal surface wear. The natural stone exteriors are intact with no structural cracks. Bases are flat and provide stable support. No significant chips or damage to the polished rims.
